regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow, dominant single narrative in Coal (rank 1, eligible, durable-trend tagged mean-revert, breadth 0.6), with Banks as the only other eligible theme (trend-state, breadth 1.0, but crowded). emerging_watch: Watching China Software & AI Apps — breadth has collapsed to 0.13 with a mean-revert tag, which historically marks the exhaustion of a former AI leadership theme. The condition to retire this watch is Software & AI Apps printing a breadth recovery above 0.5 with a durability bar above 0.4 on two consecutive weekly readings.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible theme besides Coal showing trend-state durability (0.84) with maximum internal breadth (1.0), which supports the idea that the leadership is broad within the theme. Crowding (z=1.81) caps enthusiasm, not direction. Given cross-sectional momentum rank-IC ~0, this is a durability-consistency lean, not a momentum call.
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.81 means the trade is already popular; in a mean-reverting A-share tape with gate_helps=false, crowded trend-followers often get whipsawed before durability pays off.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS underperforms CSI 300 by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the dominant narrative and eligible, but its hurst_tag is mean-revert, breadth is only 0.6 (leadership is concentrated, not broad), and the backtest verdict explicitly says momentum rank is not alpha. A mean-revert tag on the leader in a whipsawing market means chasing it at the top of attention is the documented failure mode — avoid directionally, not a short.
theses.dissent: A dominant single-narrative leader can stay dominant much longer than expected in a reflexive tape; avoiding it purely on mean-revert tag risks missing continuation.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS holds its lead and does not underperform CSI 300 by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals rank 3 with trend-state durability but eligibility=false and breadth 0.0 — an internal trend with no breadth. When the absolute-trend gate fails and breadth collapses to zero, the theme is a drawdown magnet, not an opportunity.
theses.dissent: If the broad market flips to a risk-on trend day, zero-breadth resource names can gap higher fastest as shorts cover.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS rises more than 8% relative to CSI 300 over the next 20 trading days.
